name: Generic header
summary: Use the Generic header to give a public-sector service a clear branded header when it is not entitled to use the GOV.UK crown and logotype.
whenToUse: Use for services outside the GOV.UK proposition that want a compatible GOV.UK Frontend page structure without GOV.UK identity assets.
Use a concise organisation or service name as the homepage link.
whenNotToUse: Do not use it as an imitation GOV.UK header by adding the GOV.UK crown, logotype or protected identity styling.
Do not replace the official GOV.UK header with this component when the service is authorised and required to use the GOV.UK identity.

anatomy.name: Header container
anatomy.description: A full-width header contains an aligned GOV.UK width container.

anatomy.name: Homepage link
anatomy.description: A prominent text link names the service or organisation and returns to its home page.

variants.name: Default
variants.use: A non-GOV.UK service with a short text identity.

behaviour: The Generic header requires no GOV.UK JavaScript and the homepage control is an ordinary link.
Keep the link destination stable and preserve standard browser link behaviour.
accessibility: Use a real link with a visible accessible name and sufficient contrast.
Keep the text identity legible at narrow widths and high zoom.
Do not communicate the service identity through an image or colour alone.
content: Use the official public name of the service or organisation.
Keep the name short enough to wrap predictably on small screens.
Do not add the words GOV.UK or a crown mark unless use has been explicitly authorised.
